name: NL Scholarship
provider: Nuffic (Study in NL), with the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and participating institutions

summary.fr: Bourse de 5 000 EUR pour les étudiants hors Espace économique européen qui commencent une licence (ou un master) aux Pays-Bas ; versée la première année, ce n'est pas une bourse couvrant tous les frais de scolarité. Seuls certains établissements participent, et à l'intérieur d'un établissement seules certaines filières ou écoles : vérifiez que votre programme y figure.
summary.en: A EUR 5,000 scholarship for students from outside the European Economic Area who start a bachelor’s (or master’s) in the Netherlands; paid in the first year, not a full-tuition scholarship. Only some institutions take part, and within an institution only some programmes or schools: check that your programme is on the institution's list.

howToApply.fr: Candidatez directement auprès de l'établissement : il fixe les filières participantes, ses conditions et ses dates limites (voir son site, rubrique NL Scholarship).
howToApply.en: Apply through the institution: it sets the participating programmes, its requirements and its deadlines (see its NL Scholarship page).

eligibility.quote: is meant for international students from outside the European Economic Area (EEA) who want to do their bachelor’s or master’s in the Netherlands

level.quote: is meant for international students from outside the European Economic Area (EEA) who want to do their bachelor’s or master’s in the Netherlands
You are applying for a full-time bachelor’s or master’s programme at one of the participating Dutch higher education institutions

support.quote: The scholarship amounts to € 5,000. You will receive this in the first year of your studies.

howToApply.quote: You meet the specific requirements of the institution of your choice. You can find these on the website of the institution.
Please check the website of the institution you want to apply to for the specific deadline(s).
You can find the specific closing dates and the fields of study for this academic year on the website of the institution you want to apply to.
